pages.text: Metabolism tracks protein, fat, available carbohydrates, fiber, vitamins and minerals. The WorldLogic tab shows reserves, assimilation, deficiencies and history. K opens it separately.
Bread and honey provide carbohydrates for immediate stamina. Calories then assimilate over time. Meat and fish provide protein and fat for sustained nutrition.
Salmon contains more fat than cod. Raw food is less digestible and may raise toxin load. Impaired digestive organs slow assimilation; impaired liver function slows toxin clearance.
At rest the full stamina bar recovers in 3, 5, 7, 10 or 12 seconds depending on nutrition (20 TPS, no exertion). Food and water provide separate immediate boosts. Overeating reduces efficiency.
